jobDetail.createCvForMatch: Add your skills and languages to your CV to see if this offer suits you.
jobDetail.noteHint: Why you? When you can start…
jobDetail.privacy: The recruiter sees your profile. Your phone, e-mail and CV file stay hidden until they pay to unlock them.
jobDetail.needCvText: Make your Kadou24h CV in a few minutes, or upload yours (PDF or photo), then apply.

applied.title: Application sent!
applied.text: The recruiter will review it. You’ll be told at every step.
applied.textFor: Your application for "{{title}}" is sent. You’ll be told at every step.

myApplications.title: My applications
myApplications.emptyText: Your applications and their progress will show here.

application.title: My application

ended.rejected: Your application wasn’t selected this time. Don’t give up: other offers are waiting.

application.pendingPayment: The payment isn’t confirmed yet: the store can’t see your application yet.
application.withdrawText: The recruiter will be told. You can’t apply to this offer again.

cv.title: My CV
cv.complete: Your CV is complete. Well done!
cv.documentHint: Your applications send your uploaded CV if you have one, else the Kadou24h CV made from this profile.
cv.pdfInApp: The PDF is made in the mobile app.
cv.fillFirst: First add your job title, a summary or an experience.
cv.ownCvHint: Already have a CV? Upload it (PDF or photo).
cv.summaryEmpty: A few lines about you: what you can do, what you’re looking for.
cv.experienceEmpty: Your jobs, internships or side jobs.
cv.skillsEmpty: What you can do and the languages you speak.
cv.skillsHint: E.g. Sales, Excel, Riding a moto
cv.summaryHint: Write it yourself or start from a suggestion.
cv.suggestHint: The suggestion is built from your job title, skills and experience. Read it and adapt it.
cv.educationIncomplete: Fill in the degree, school and year (4 digits) of each education.
cv.workerOff: Customers can find you and message you for work.
cv.workerHint: Customers find you in the workers list and message you in the app chat.
cv.workerSwitch: Show me in the workers list
cv.rateHint: You can always discuss it with the customer.
cv.workerPrivacy: Your number is never shown: customers message you in the app.
cv.listedOn: You’re shown in the workers list.
cv.listedOff: You’re no longer shown in the workers list.
cv.boostHint: Appear at the top of the workers list.

plans.title: Boost my profile
plans.intro: Creating your CV and applying is free. A plan puts your profile at the top of the workers list for its duration.
plans.featureVisibility: Your profile at the top of the workers list
plans.payText: Your profile will be boosted for {{count}} days from the payment.
plans.extendText: The new period starts when your current plan ends.
plans.introWorker: After your 30 free days, a subscription keeps you visible to customers (profile, work photos, skills).

spontaneous.title: Spontaneous application
spontaneous.text: Your CV is sent to {{store}}, even without a published offer. The store gets it once the fee is paid.
spontaneous.noteHint: The position you’d like, when you can start…

received.title: Received applications
received.hint: People who want to work in your store.
received.emptyText: Spontaneous applications sent to your store will show here.

recruiter.title: My job offers
recruiter.emptyText: Post an offer: it stays live for 30 days.

recruiterJob.title: My offer
recruiterJob.closeText: It leaves the offers and nobody can apply any more. You keep the applications received.
recruiterJob.noCandidatesOpen: Applications arrive here. You’re told about each new one.
recruiterJob.noCandidatesClosed: Publish the offer to get applications.

jobForm.aboutHint: The daily work, the team, the hours…
jobForm.salaryOrder: The minimum salary is above the maximum.
jobForm.candidatesHint: Candidates see their % match with these skills and languages.
jobForm.publishInfo: Publishing costs {{amount}} GNF: the offer stays live for 30 days. You can also save it as a draft.
jobForm.publishText: Your offer will be visible to everyone for 30 days. You’ll get the applications here.

candidate.title: Candidate
candidate.lockedText: Phone, e-mail and CV file are hidden. Unlock them once for this candidate.
candidate.unlockText: You’ll see {{name}}’s phone, e-mail and CV file, for all their applications with you.
candidate.noCvFile: No CV file: see the profile above.

confirmText.hired: The candidate is told the good news.
confirmText.rejected: The candidate is told, politely. You can change your mind.

candidate.inviteHint: The candidate gets the date, time and place, and can confirm.
candidate.badDate: Enter a future date (DD/MM/YYYY) and a time (10:30).
candidate.badLink: The link must start with https://

booking.title: Booking
booking.guest: Sign in to book a worker and follow your bookings.
booking.emptyCustomerText: Find an electrician, a plumber, a mason… and book them in seconds.

text.accepted_customer: Their number is shown below. Agree on the price before the work starts.
text.accepted_worker: The customer’s number and full address are shown. When the job is finished, tap “Job done”.
text.done_customer: Check the work before paying, then confirm. Without an answer it is confirmed automatically on {{date}}.
text.done_worker: The customer has to confirm. Without an answer it is automatic on {{date}}.
text.completed_customer: Thank you! Your review helps other customers.
text.completed_worker: Well done, this job counts in your worker dashboard.
text.expired_customer: The worker did not answer in time. You can book someone else.
text.expired_worker: You did not answer within 24 h.

booking.answerWithin: Answer within {{time}}, or the request expires.
booking.waitingAnswer: Waiting for the worker’s answer ({{time}} max).
booking.confirmPrompt: The worker has finished: please confirm.
booking.usuallyOff: This worker does not usually work that day: they may decline.
booking.noSlots: No time left that day. Choose another day.
booking.whatHint: E.g. install 3 sockets in the living room, the door no longer closes…
booking.photosHint: Photos (optional, {{count}} max): help the worker understand.
booking.info2: Their number appears as soon as they accept.
booking.info3: You pay the worker directly (cash or Orange Money), not in the app.
booking.sent: Request sent. The worker will answer.

need.when: Choose a day and a time.
need.address: Choose where the work will be done.

booking.limitedBanner: After several cancellations you can only have one booking at a time until {{date}}.

safety.title: Kadou24h connects clients and providers, but does not guarantee payments made outside the application.
safety.book: We recommend that you verify the completed work before making the payment, and never pay in advance in full for work not yet done.
safety.confirm: Check the completed work before paying and confirming. Never pay for work not yet done.
safety.accept: We recommend that you clearly clarify the price and payment terms with the client before starting the service.
safety.register: Customers pay you directly (cash or Orange Money). Always clarify the price and payment terms before you start.
safety.complete: Make sure the price and the payment were settled with the client as agreed.

booking.phoneAfterAccept: The number appears once the request is accepted.
booking.addressAfterAccept: The full address and landmark appear when you accept.
booking.agreedPriceHint: Only for your own tracking (“estimated earnings”). The customer pays you directly.
booking.confirmed: Thank you! The job is confirmed.
booking.acceptText: The customer will see your number and you will see their full address. Cancelling later counts as a cancellation (warning, then reduced visibility, then suspension).
booking.acceptedToast: Request accepted. Call the customer to agree on the details.
booking.declineText: Declining never leads to a penalty.
booking.cancelFree: The request is not accepted yet: cancelling it never leads to a penalty.
booking.cancelCountsWorker: Cancelling an accepted job counts over 30 days: 1st time a warning, 2nd time your profile is less visible for 15 days, 3rd time a 7-day suspension.
booking.cancelCountsCustomer: The worker already accepted: this cancellation counts. After 3 cancellations in 30 days, you can only have one booking at a time.
booking.notDoneText: Tell the worker what is left to do. The booking goes back to “accepted”.
booking.reviewPhotos: Add a photo of the finished work (optional).

penalty.workerWarning: You have canceled an accepted reservation. Please respect your commitments to the clients; a repeat offense will reduce your visibility.
penalty.workerLessVisible_one: Due to a second cancellation this month, your profile is temporarily less visible for {{count}} day (until {{date}}). A third cancellation will result in a suspension or restriction of your bookings.
penalty.workerLessVisible_other: Due to a second cancellation this month, your profile is temporarily less visible for {{count}} days (until {{date}}). A third cancellation will result in a suspension or restriction of your bookings.
penalty.workerSuspended: Third cancellation in 30 days: your profile is suspended until {{date}} (customers can’t see you). After that, one booking at a time until {{limit}}.
penalty.customerWarning: You cancelled an accepted booking. Please respect your commitments: after 3 cancellations in 30 days, your bookings will be limited.
penalty.customerLimited: After several cancellations this month, you can only have one booking at a time until {{date}}.

entry.title: Moto-taxi
entry.text: Go from A to B. Price known before ordering, paid in cash.

ride.title: Ride {{number}}

new.pickupHint: Put the pin where the rider should pick you up.
new.dropoffHint: Put the pin on your destination.
new.ridersNearby_one: {{count}} rider available near you. The first to accept comes to pick you up.
new.ridersNearby_other: {{count}} riders available near you. The first to accept comes to pick you up.
new.noRiderNearby: No rider available close by right now. You can still order: the request widens for 10 minutes.
new.noteHint: E.g. in front of the pharmacy, blue gate
new.safety: For your safety: check the rider’s name and plate before getting on, and wear a helmet.

ride.searchingText: Nearby riders can see your request. The first to accept comes to pick you up.
ride.arrivedText: Your rider is at the pickup point.
ride.completedText: Ride finished. Pay {{amount}} in cash to the rider.
ride.expiredText: No rider accepted your ride. Try again in a few minutes.
ride.safety: Never share bank details. If something goes wrong, contact Kadou24h support.
ride.cancelTextSearching: The request is withdrawn for every rider.
ride.cancelTextRider: Your rider is already on the way: they will be told.
ride.emptyPassenger: Order a moto to go from A to B.
ride.emptyRider: Nearby passengers show up under "Near me" while you are online.

rider.title: Moto-taxi ride
rider.accepted: Ride accepted: go and pick up the passenger
rider.collectAtEnd: At the end, collect {{amount}} in cash.
rider.dropText: It goes to the other nearby riders and you won’t see it again.
